detail.name: Asaba Harumasa's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Asaba Harumasa's Mindscape: White Lies
detail.desc2:
A card with the image of a HSO Section 6 member printed on it.
This card has two printed editions with the only difference being the contact number. For one of these versions, the only thing that one will hear when calling is a notice that the number they have dialed does not exist... Apparently, most of the victims of this are the bigwigs at HSO.
